spec.consumer_description: Calculates intervals, easiness factor, and review schedule based on recall score (0-5).

requirements.statement: Throws RangeError if grade is not an integer between 0 and 5 inclusive
Grade >= 3 increments repetitions and expands interval (interval=1 on rep 0, interval=6 on rep 1, interval=round(interval*ease) subsequently)
Grade < 3 resets repetitions to 0, sets interval to 1 day, and increments lapse count
Ease factor cannot drop below MIN_EASE (1.30)
Cards with lapses >= 8 are flagged as leeches

exports.name: scheduleReview
exports.signature: (card: CardState, grade: number, now: number) => CardState
exports.description: Computes updated card state with next due date and ease

exports.name: updateEase
exports.description: Calculates new ease factor bounded below by 1.30
